title: Known Completely
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
Known Completely | God’s Omniscience, God’s Presence, Life in the Womb, and a Pure Heart - Psalm v139

God knows us completely—our thoughts, our words, our steps, and even the days of our lives before they unfold. In Psalm v139, we are reminded that there is nowhere we can run from His presence and nothing hidden from His sight. What feels overwhelming becomes a deep comfort: the Lord sees us fully and still holds us in His hand.

From the womb to eternity, God’s care is personal and purposeful. We are fearfully and wonderfully made, formed by His design and never forgotten. Because He knows us so intimately, our right response is not to hide, but to surrender—asking Him to search our hearts, cleanse what is sinful, and lead us in the everlasting way with clean hands and a pure heart.
